name: Rend Mind
desc: When you use your Psychic Blades to deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can force it to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, it has the Stunned condition for 1 minute; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once per Long Rest, unless you expend three Psionic Energy Dice to use it again.
